mapper.sql: user_block_id, blocker_user_no, blocked_user_no, reason, created_at, is_deleted, deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ultary_user_block WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND ( (blocker_user_no = #{userNoA} AND blocked_user_no = #{userNoB}) OR (blocker_user_no = #{userNoB} AND blocked_user_no = #{userNoA}) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN blocker_user_no = #{userNoA} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ultary_user_block SET is_deleted = 0, deleted_at = NULL, created_at = NOW() WHERE user_block_id = #{userBlockId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname AS nickname, ( SELECT rp.profile_file_id FROM ultary_pet rp WHERE rp.user_no = u.user_no AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.profile_file_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rp.priority ASC, rp.pet_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS profileFileId, b.created_at AS blockedAt FROM ultary_user_block b INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = b.blocked_user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE b.blocker_user_no = #{blockerUserNo} AND b.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.user_block_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
